notes: Two cosmetic defects fixed on top of the 21 September rebuild, and nothing else. (1) The net-move tile's headline reads -EUR 1.01 while the four terms beneath it add to -1.02, because each term is rounded to the cent on its own; the tile now says so in one short line on its own terms line. The note had to share that line rather than take a line of its own: an extra line made the tile 15 px taller and on the ISZE clock pushed the page's own 'More controls' control below the fold, where the page's gate could no longer click it (that was the single gate failure seen on the first attempt, and the note's placement is what fixed it). (2) The fleet table's totals row had an empty basis cell; the row now prints a single basis when every row above it carries the same one and a dash when they differ, which on the default view is 'estimate'. No figure, chart, order or wording elsewhere was touched, and the two deliberate notes about the agreed and internal schedules were left as they are.
